{{Top|leg}}
The '''M39 ComTech''' was a [[Jammer/Legends|jamming unit]] developed by [[MicroThrust Processors|MicroThrust]] as a method of protection against eavesdropping. The unit emitted a range of background static, thereby preventing communication [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] from detecting vocal or electronic communication.
